title: Pupil PDF worksheet (draw and tick; printable or for a drawing tablet) (lesson 7)
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y2 lesson 7 (Pupil PDF worksheet (draw and tick; printable or for a drawing tablet))
intro: Lesson 7: Who likes chocolate? Foods from around the world. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

box.title: Draw a plate with one food from another country. Write its name and the country.

keywords.def: a land with its own people and foods
the bean chocolate is made from

questions.q: Sort these: apple, dates, pork sausage, rice. Which are halal?
questions.a: Apple, dates and rice are halal; pork is not.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: draw a plate with one food from another country and write its name and the country.
questions.a: A plate with a named food and country.

questions.q: Extend: say the eating manners in order.
questions.a: Wash, Bismillah, right hand, from in front, alhamdulillah.

questions.q: Which is a good eating manner?
questions.a: A) Saying Bismillah first. We say Bismillah and eat with the right hand.

questions.q: Think again: Chocolate comes from a bean that grows on a tree far away. How many people do you think help to bring one bar to you?
questions.a: Many: farmers, drivers, factory workers, ship crews, shopkeepers. We thank Allah and them.
